title: MH SSC Class 10 Geometry
summary: Maharashtra State Board Class 10 Geometry board questions, 2016 to 2026, five a day. Questions the board asked again come first, highest count first, then the question types it keeps asking, then every other question.
note: Repeats were found by reading every question of each chapter against the others, across the board papers from March 2016 to June 2026 (March and supplementary sittings), plus a cross-chapter check. Five Trigonometry questions of the pre-2019 syllabus (angles in standard position, negative angles) are left out.
